ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all UBOs, directors, resident agents, and authorized signatories against OFAC SDN List, UN Consolidated Sanctions List, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, UK HMT Sanctions List, and the Panama Financial Analysis Unit (UAF) domestic listing. Enhanced due diligence mandatory for politically exposed persons (PEPs): identification of source of wealth and source of funds, senior management approval of the business relationship, and ongoing transaction monitoring. Suspicious transaction reports to UAF are required under Ley 23 as amended. Defense-sector related activity additionally requires submission of UBO certification to the Ministry of Public Security and the Ministry of Commerce and Industries.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Público de Panamá – Dirección General de Empresas y Fundaciones (online name clearance and reservation through the official website of the Registro Público de Panamá, www.registro-publico.gob.pa)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: All corporate names must be expressible in Latin script. Spanish and English names are accepted; names in non-Latin scripts (e.g., Chinese, Arabic, Cyrillic) must be transliterated into Latin characters. The name must end with the expression 'Sociedad Anónima' or the abbreviation 'S.A.'. Names that are merely descriptive, misleading, or identical or deceptively similar to an existing registered name are rejected. Suffixes such as 'Inc.', 'Corp' or 'Limited' are not acceptable for a Panamanian S.A.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If a name is rejected, the applicant must file a written 'Recurso de Reconsideración' with the Dirección General de Empresas y Fundaciones within 5 business days of notification. If the reconsideration is denied, a further 'Recurso de Apelación' must be filed within 5 business days with the higher administrative authority of the Registro Público. After exhaustion of the administrative remedies, a judicial action may be brought before the Sala Tercera de lo Contencioso-Administrativo de la Corte Suprema de Justicia within 30 business days. Name reservations may be renewed for one additional 30-day period upon written request before expiration.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office may be used as a registered agent office for correspondence and legal service purposes, but it will not satisfy commercial substance requirements for ISIC 3040 defense manufacturing. The Ministry of Commerce and Industries, together with the Ministry of Public Security, requires a physical manufacturing plant, industrial zoning authorization, and on-site security systems. Virtual office arrangements are insufficient to obtain the special license for armored military tactical vehicle manufacturing.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: High, estimated above 85% for defense-sector licensed manufacturers. The Ministry of Public Security, Ministry of Commerce and Industries, the Financial Analysis Unit (UAF), and the National Customs Authority may conduct unannounced physical on-site inspections to verify production capacity, export compliance, and AML/CFT controls.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Panama Companies Law (Law 32 of 1927, as amended by Law 5 of 1997 and subsequent reforms); Arts. 1-62 and 73-113 of the consolidated Companies Code of the Public Registry.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Public Registry of Panama (Registro Publico de Panamá), Mercantile Section (Sección Mercantil)
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Escritura Pública de Constitución de Sociedad Anónima (Public Deed of Incorporation) and subsequent Asiento Registral in the Mercantile Registry
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital; capital is freely fixed in the articles. Shares may be issued for cash or non-cash consideration. No mandatory escrow account is required for ordinary Sociedad Anónima formation; the subscribed capital is declared to the Public Registry and municipal authorities.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the corporation accepts the subscriptions to its initial share capital as set forth in the Articles of Incorporation, with authorized capital of US$50,000 represented by 50,000 common shares of US$1.00 each, and such shares are deemed duly subscribed and issued to the founding shareholders in exchange for cash consideration. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the registered office be fixed at Suite 101, Global Finance Plaza, Calle 55, Panama City, Republic of Panama, and the registered agent services be confirmed. RESOLVED FURTHER, that John Doe be appointed President and Legal Representative, Jane Smith as Secretary, and Richard Roe as Treasurer, each with full power to execute all incorporation filings, register bank accounts, and manage day-to-day operations.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Draft and Notarize the Articles of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public of the Circuit of Panama (Notaría Pública)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Retain a Panamanian attorney to search the corporate name at the Public Registry and draft the Pacto Social y Estatutos (articles and bylaws). Appear before the notary with the subscribing shareholders or their Attorney-in-Fact to sign the public deed. The notary will certify the deed and produce certified copies.
required_dossiers: Passport copies of shareholders and directors
Power of attorney if executed by an attorney-in-fact
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary raises defects regarding the corporate purpose or capital provisions, amend the deed accordingly and re-execute before the same notary.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Register the Company with the Mercantile Section of the Public Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Public Registry of Panama, Mercantile Section
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the notarized public deed and the registry request form with the Public Registry. Pay the official registration fees. The Registry will review the deed and, upon approval, issue the 'Ficha' (mercantile registration certificate) recording the corporation.
required_dossiers: Certified copy of the notarized public deed
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registry issues a notice of deficiencies, submit a written response with corrected clauses and pay any recalibration fee to obtain registration.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtain the RUC Tax Identification Number from the DGI
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Directorate General of Revenue (DGI), Ministry of Economy and Finance
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the RUC application form with the DGI using the registered corporate data and declared business activity (ISIC 3040). Provide the corporate certificates and authorization for the fiscal representative. The DGI will validate the territorial tax regime status and issue the RUC number.
required_dossiers: Copy of the legal representative's ID/passport
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Correct inconsistencies in the corporate name or fiscal address noted by DGI and resubmit the application at the RUC service window.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtain the Municipal Business License (Aviso de Operación)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Mayor of Panama (Alcaldía de Panamá), Municipal Economic Activities Office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Apply at the municipal window for the industrial operation permit. Present the corporation's RUC and Ficha, lease or property title, and the economic activity schedule. Pay the annual municipal tax based on authorized capital to receive the Aviso de Operación.
required_dossiers: Copy of operating lease or property deed
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Municipality issues a query about the described industrial activity, file an amended declaration with the municipal treasurer and obtain a corrected license.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Register as an Employer with CSS and MITRADEL
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Caja de Seguro Social (CSS) and Ministry of Labor and Workforce Development (MITRADEL)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register the corporation as an employer with the Social Security Fund for employer contributions and worker insurance. Simultaneously, file the company's standing with MITRADEL for workplace occupational health and safety compliance. Obtain the employer and risk codes.
required_dossiers: Factory lease or owned property document
Initial payroll listing and occupational descriptions
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Rectify employee classification or workplace address errors and re-submit to the CSS or MITRADEL employer registration unit.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Open the Corporate Bank Account and Deposit Paid-in Capital
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Commercial bank licensed by the Superintendency of Banks of Panama
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Present the corporate pack to the selected bank's compliance department. Provide the board resolution authorizing the account opening and designation of signatories. Execute the required client due diligence forms and deposit the minimum paid-in capital into the newly opened corporate account.
required_dossiers: Passport copies and source-of-funds evidence for beneficial owners
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank's compliance department requests additional KYC or source of funds documents, submit the required evidence or amend the signatories to satisfy the bank's policy.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministry of Commerce and Industries (MICI), General Directorate of Industry (Dirección General de Industrias)
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Special Industrial Manufacturing License for Armored Security Personnel Transport Vehicles (ISIC 3040) – Defense Industry Permit, jointly issued by MICI and the Ministry of Public Security

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Environment of Panama (Ministerio de Ambiente, MiAMBIENTE)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category II – Moderate Impact Activity requiring an Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA) for metal-mechanical manufacturing with welding, painting, and armored vehicle testing
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater per Executive Decree 389 of 2001: pH 6-9, BOD5 <= 100 mg/L, TSS <= 75 mg/L, oil and grease <= 10 mg/L. Air emissions per Executive Decree 168 of 2000: particulate matter <= 50 mg/Nm3; volatile organic compounds (VOC) in painting operations comply with USEPA GPG guidance (3.5 lb VOC per gallon). Hazardous wastes managed under Law 14 of 2003 with waste manifest and authorized disposer.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certificate from the Cuerpo de Bomberos de Panamá; municipal structural load inspection for the manufacturing plant; MITRADEL occupational safety and hygiene clearance for industrial operations; and ballistic/live-fire testing clearance from the Ministry of Public Security for armored vehicle test ranges.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI), Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas de Panamá; official portal: SITIO (Sistema Integrado de Información Tributaria) at https://sitio.dgi.gob.pa
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Foreign entities must appoint a resident legal representative and obtain an RUC (Registro Único de Contribuyentes) by submitting incorporation documents, notarized appointment of representative, proof of registered address in Panama, and registering for the taxpayer registry at DGI. RUC issuance is prerequisite for ITBMS registration and customs operations. Processing is done online via SITIO or in-person at DGI offices.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Panama does not operate a check-the-box regime. No elective pass-through treatment exists for Sociedad Anónima. Tax consolidation is not available for income tax. Foreign entities may elect to register under the Multinational Headquarters (SEM) regime only with separate authorization from the SEM Commission.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: ITBMS (Impuesto de Transferencia de Bienes Muebles y Servicios), Panama's VAT-equivalent
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No statutory turnover threshold for general registration in the ITBMS; any person or entity engaged in taxable economic activities within Panamanian territory must register. A simplified small-taxpayer regime exists for annual gross income of up to PAB/USD 30,000, subject to DGI approval.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Panama mandates electronic invoicing through the DIGIFACT system administered by the DGI. Authorized taxpayers must transmit electronic invoices (facturas electrónicas) and credit/debit notes in SPL (Sistema de Facturación Electrónica) format using a digital certificate issued by the General Directorate of Public Revenue. Eligible taxpayers pay a fee for the 'Sello Digital' (digital stamp). Real-time validation with DGI servers is required for high-risk taxpayers; phased roll-out applies by turnover and economic activity sector. Exporters must incorporate customs exit records in the electronic invoice flow.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of goods and services (including services rendered to non-residents and supplies for the operation of the Panama Canal, free trade zones, and Panama-Pacifico) are subject to 0% ITBMS. Eligibility requires the taxpayer to hold a valid RUC and an exporter certificate issued by the DGI, demonstrate that the goods or title to the goods physically left Panamanian territory (or, for services, that the recipient is a non-resident and the benefit is realized outside Panama), and maintain complete transactional records evidencing a direct causal link between the export sale and input costs. Zero-rating also applies to supplies to vessels in international traffic and commercial aircraft operations.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Declaración de Exportación) duly validated by the National Customs Authority – full exit record
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill evidencing physical export and destination
Inward Remittance Certificate / bank transfer proof from the foreign buyer demonstrating actual payment remittance
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Panama applies strict audit scrutiny to export zero-ratings. If the DGI determines that zero-rating was improperly claimed, it will claw back the ITBMS not paid, plus interest from the date the tax originally became due, and impose fines under Article 756 of the Tax Code (typically 100% of the omitted tax when fraud is found). Intentional submission of false customs or invoice documentation may trigger criminal tax fraud charges (Ley Penal Tributaria) with penalties of imprisonment up to 5 years and additional monetary sanctions. Exporter blacklisting and suspension of the exporter certificate may also apply.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Superintendencia de Bancos de Panamá (SBP), established by Decree Law No. 2 of 2008, is the sole prudential banking regulator; Banco Nacional de Panamá acts as fiscal and clearing agent of the State; no traditional central bank exists under Panama's dollarized monetary framework in force since 1904.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Panama is a fully dollarized jurisdiction: the US dollar is legal tender and circulates freely, while the Balboa (PAB) exists only as sub-unit coinage pegged 1:1. There is total currency convertibility on both current-account and capital-account transactions; no prior exchange-control authorization, no capital-account licensing, and no profit-remittance approval are required. Dividends and branch profits may be remitted freely, subject only to Panama's territorial-source tax and the 5% dividend tax on active income; FATF increased-monitoring (grey-list) status raises EDD intensity but does not create FX conversion hurdles.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: None exist. Panama imposes no statutory timeline, no mandatory conversion ratio, and no repatriation obligation for export receipts. Defense-tactical export proceeds may be retained indefinitely in USD or any foreign currency, subject only to AML/CFT books-and-records obligations under Law 23 of 2015 and SBP customer-due-diligence rules.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Current Account and USD Capital Escrow Sub-Account
Operational Account for Sovereign Procurement Settlement

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low. Law 123 of 2020 permits SBP-supervised fintech innovation licenses, but major offshore EMIs (UK/EU e-money institutions) universally exclude military-tactical hardware supply chains under acceptable-use policies. A domestic SBP-licensed digital-payment provider could support local collection only; the Government_Direct_Wire and Diplomatic_LC rails require a full-service SBP-licensed correspondent bank, so EMIs cannot anchor this treasury structure.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Mandatory physical attendance for high-risk defense-adjacent clients. At least one director and the ultimate beneficial owner (or their Panama-licensed attorney-in-fact holding an apostilled notarized mandate) must appear in person at the bank's Panama office for an enhanced due-diligence interview. Fully remote or video-only onboarding of a military-vehicle manufacturer is not available in practice under current SBP supervisory expectations and FATF increased-monitoring pressure.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Ultimate Beneficial Ownership (UBO) opacity arising from bearer-share history, private-interest-foundation (PIF) layering, or incomplete final-beneficiary registry filings
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified Final Beneficiary Registry (Registro Único de Beneficiarios Finales) filing certificate from the Dirección General de Ingresos; full corporate-ownership flowchart through every PIF and S.A.; notarized and apostilled trust/private-foundation deeds; sworn UBO identification affidavit; and written confirmation that bearer shares are immobilized or cancelled under Law 254 of 2021.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: OFAC/EU/UN sanctions exposure and military end-user risk associated with armored-vehicle exports
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Institutional sanctions-compliance manual; transaction-screening logs applying the OFAC 50% rule plus EU and UN consolidated lists; executed End-User Certificate (EUC) and no-re-export/no-transshipment undertakings for every defense contract; verified final-destination documentation for diplomatic sales; and a legal due-diligence memorandum on each foreign counterparty.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Enhanced scrutiny triggered by FATF grey-list designation and the defense sector's High-Risk_Special_License classification
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: FATF remediation evidence pack: audited financial statements, RUC tax-standing certificate, Social Security and payroll records, physical-substance lease agreement for the Panama assembly facility, valid defense-manufacturing/export license from Panama's Ministry of Public Security and competent arms-trade authorities, and a negative-media report from a recognized due-diligence provider.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Source-of-wealth insufficiency during capital-escrow funding and shareholder-loan injection
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Three years of corporate tax returns; audited balance sheet and income statement; shareholders' source-of-wealth declarations supported by purchase/sale agreements; executed board capital-call resolutions; and original bank reference letters issued by the remitting shareholder's regulated correspondent institution.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Third-party payment flows and diplomatic/embassy settlement patterns inconsistent with invoice beneficiaries
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Original government procurement contract or diplomatic sales agreement; diplomatic note or ministry authentication letter; embassy payment authorization and end-use certification; full commercial invoice package with bill of lading and packing list; and an approved-payer beneficiary list with prior written notice for any Government_Direct_Wire payment.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: All equity injections and shareholder loans must arrive via SWIFT MT103 from the shareholder's own account at a regulated financial institution into the Panama corporate account. The wire narrative must state 'FDI – Equity Subscription – Armored Vehicle Manufacturing (ISIC 3040)' and include the S.A.'s RUC number. Treasury verifies that the remitter matches the registered shareholder; third-party remitters are rejected; cash, crypto-bridge transfers, and unlicensed intermediaries are prohibited. Because Panama is dollarized, no central-bank authorization certificate or FX approval is required.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Trade settlements use four clearing rails: (1) SWIFT MT103 for direct progress payments to foreign component suppliers; (2) irrevocable documentary Letters of Credit under UCP 600 for Government_Direct_Wire and Diplomatic_LC end-customer sales; (3) standby Letters of Credit under ISP98 for performance guarantees on sovereign contracts; and (4) SWIFT MT202 interbank cover for vendor-bank credits. Each disbursement is condition-checked against the approved-beneficiary list, underlying contract, commercial invoice, bill of lading, export license, and, for military goods, the End-User Certificate and final-destination documentation.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable USD/EUR and USD/GBP FX forwards executed with SBP-licensed international-class banks
Non-Deliverable Forwards (NDFs) on emerging-market procurement currencies (COP, MXN, DOP) booked through offshore bank treasury desks
Cross-currency swaps (USD/EUR and USD/GBP) matching long-duration government and diplomatic supply-contract cash flows
FX options and collar structures limited strictly to bona fide procurement exposure hedging with zero speculative intent
Multi-currency nostro settlement with market-fix spot conversion as a permitted non-speculative treasury mechanism

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Panama applies a territorial tax base: only Panama-source income is subject to the 25% corporate income tax (ISR). Preferential regimes include: 100% ISR and import-duty exemptions for licensed companies in Panama Pacifico Special Economic Zone; 10-year ISR exemption for qualifying call-centre activities; 15-year exemption for technology/innovation parks; tax credits for reforestation; and accelerated depreciation for qualifying productive assets. Manufacturing of armoured tactical vehicles is not itself a statutory tax holiday, but the taxpayer may access territorial exclusions for foreign-source export revenue and special IP-box treatment is not available.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form 2 (Declaración Jurada de Renta) filed via the DGI (Dirección General de Ingresos) electronic filing platform at https://dgi.gob.pa, through the 'Sistema de Declaraciones Electrónicas' (SDE) using the taxpayer's NIT and digital certificate.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual corporate income tax return; quarterly estimated payments and monthly ITBM/VAT declarations are ancillary obligations.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: For a taxable year ending 31 December, the return and final payment are due no later than 31 March of the subsequent year; for a non-calendar fiscal year, the deadline is within three months after the end of the fiscal year.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxpayer identification: NIT, registered trade name, fiscal period, and activity ISIC code.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the Panama S.A. NIT and full corporate details; do not use the foreign parent's tax identification for the taxable entity. The ultimate beneficial owner must be disclosed through the Beneficial Owner Registry (Law 23 of 2015) before filing.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross receipts from Panama-source sales and services; separately identified foreign-source receipts.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Only Panamanian-source receipts are taxable. Revenue from exports of all-terrain tactical vehicles to military buyers outside Panama must be supported by bills of lading, contracts, and banking evidence and may be excluded as foreign-source income if no economic activity occurred in Panama.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Deductible operating costs, depreciation, scientific/technological expenses, and net taxable income after NOL carry-forward.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Deductions claimed against Panama-source income must be backed by electronic invoices and bank wire evidence. Payments to a foreign affiliate for IP, services, or intra-group goods must satisfy transfer pricing documentation to be deductible.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Calculated ISR at 25%, advance payments, and balance due or credit.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident filing representatives should reconcile all quarterly estimated payments and attach Form 2 annexes for any tax withheld at source. Failure to pay the balance due triggers immediate enforcement.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: surcharge of 5% to 25% of the tax due, plus monthly interest at 1.5% (18% per annum) on unpaid tax; inaccurate or fraudulent returns attract a 100% to 200% penalty; failure to file, after DGI notification, allows the tax authority to assess a 'presumptive' tax and impose daily administrative fines; the corporate registry can refuse to issue 'Paz y Salvo' (tax clearance), blocking licences and government defence contracts.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% final dividend withholding tax on gross distributions to shareholders, regardless of residence. The Panama paying company is the withholding agent; distributions from profits already taxed in Panama may carry an imputation credit, eliminating residual double taxation in most domestic cases. There is no separate branch remittance tax.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Panama maintains a narrow DTA network (e.g., Barbados, Mexico, South Korea, Singapore and limited agreements). To invoke treaty-reduced WHT, a shareholder must submit the Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) issued by the treaty jurisdiction bank and legalized to the DGI through the 'Sistema de Retenciones' prior to distribution. The request must identify the beneficial owner, prove entitlement under the LOB (limitation-on-benefits) clause, and be filed with the annual Form 2. If no advance treaty certification is obtained, the payor must apply the statutory 10% and the shareholder may reclaim overwithholding by filing a refund application with DGI.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory Panama-source WHT: 12.5% on royalties for use of IP in Panama and 12.5% on interest paid to non-resident lenders/financiers (unless the creditor is a recognized international banking institution, where preferential treatment may apply). Treaty rates under Panama's DTAs are typically reduced to 5-10% on royalties and interest; no treaty relief is available without prior TRC and beneficial-owner certification.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: B/. 2,000,000 (2,000,000 Panamanian Balboas, equivalent to USD 2,000,000) of aggregate related-party transactions per fiscal year; transactions with affiliates resident in zero/low-tax jurisdictions and all high-risk defence-sector supply chains are given special scrutiny even below threshold.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Panama's Economic Substance Regulations (Law 254 of 2021, implementing OECD/EU pressures) require a Panama tax-resident company carrying on a 'relevant activity' (including manufacturing, distribution, and financing) to demonstrate in Panama: (i) physical premises, (ii) qualified full-time employees, (iii) real expenditure proportionate to income, and (iv) senior management/board decisions in Panama. A PMC S.A. engaged in ISIC 3040 military-vehicle production must also hold the Ministerio de Comercio e Industrias (MICI) manufacturing licence and any arms/defence-export permit issued by the competent Panamanian security authority; absence of substance converts the S.A. into a reportable shell entity, risks cancellation of the licence, and triggers exchange-of-information sanctions.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion and False Tax Declarations
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Suppressing Panama-source income, using forged or backdated invoices, claiming deductions for non-existent military-equipment costs, or knowingly misclassifying domestic revenue as foreign-source revenue to exploit Panama's territorial system.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under Panamanian Fiscal Code (in force with Law 69 of 2015 aggravation rules), evaded tax is assessed with a 100% penalty plus 1.5% monthly interest; criminal tax evasion carries a fine of 2 to 5 times the evaded amount and imprisonment of 2 to 5 years. The DGI may close the establishment and publish the taxpayer in the delinquent-taxpayer list.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors, administrators, and accountants who sign false returns are jointly and severally liable for the tax debt. Judicial proceedings can freeze personal bank accounts, impose travel bans, and order extradition (under bilateral agreements) for directors abroad. Directors' personal visas and Panamanian residency may be revoked.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company and Economic Substance Failure
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating a Panama S.A. as a bare invoicing conduit with nominee directors, no employees or physical plant, no board meetings in Panama, or using the military-vehicle ISIC as a façade for asset protection or trade-based money laundering.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Non-compliance with Law 254 of 2021 substance regulations triggers written warning, a corrective period, and penalties up to 1% of retained economic activity revenues (minimum B/. 10,000). The Economic Substance Compliance Unit may impose fines of up to B/. 100,000 and strike the entity from the tax registry; DGI may treat the entity as 'tax resident of a no-substance jurisdiction' and deny treaty benefits.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors of shell entities face administrative fines of B/. 10,000-100,000, disqualification from holding directorships in Panama, personal civil liability for corporate tax debts under reverse-veil-piercing theories, and criminal exposure for false filings if the DGI proves wilful misconduct.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Defence-Sector AML and Arms Embargo Violations
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Accepting cash or wire transfers from sanctioned state-military end-users, concealing the ultimate beneficial owner of the buying entity, delivering all-terrain military vehicles to embargoed countries, or omitting the mandatory arms-trafficking control registration with the Panamanian Ministry of Security.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Law 23 of 2015 (Panama AML/CFT) authorizes fines up to B/. 1,000,000 for regulated entities; criminal money-laundering under Panamanian Criminal Code Article 277 carries 5 to 12 years' imprisonment per count plus confiscation of vehicles, bank accounts, and intermediate companies. The Ministry of Commerce can cancel the manufacturing/export licence, and the Office of the Comptroller will flag the company to FinCEN and OFAC networks.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are personally indictable for money laundering if they knew or wilfully ignored the illicit origin or destination of funds; travel bans and Interpol red notices apply to directors abroad; bank-account freezes and forfeiture orders extend to personal property traced to the offence.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Setting intercompany prices for armoured-vehicle components, royalties, or management fees outside arm's length, failing to file the Panamanian TP informative return (Declaración Informativa de Precios de Transferencia), or neglecting to withhold 10% dividend WHT on distributions to the foreign parent.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: DGI can make TP adjustments and impose a 40% surcharge on any adjustment; unpaid withholding taxes are collected with a 100%-200% penalty for failure to withhold. The tax lien attaches to all corporate assets and government receivables.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Non-withholding is a personal statutory liability: directors and the legal representative are jointly liable for the unwithheld amount, plus interest. Serious repeat violations can lead to criminal charges for misappropriation of public tax funds and a personal travel ban until the tax debt is satisfied.
